name: Enhanced Internal Microphone
summary: Adds an 'Enhanced Microphone' input built with PipeWire's own filter-chain: high-pass at 85 Hz, gentle warmth and presence EQ, a soft compressor and a safety clamp against clipping, and makes it the default input. Uses only components that ship with SteamOS; the original microphone stays available.
restart: Nothing. Select 'Enhanced Microphone' as input in apps that do not follow the system default.
